segments.text: I nearly skidded off the road.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker mentions that their car almost slid out of control off the roadway.
The speaker points out that transparent road ice is almost impossible to see.

segments.text: You should have taken the back roads instead of the motorway.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker suggests that taking smaller side roads rather than the highway would have been a better choice.

segments.text: They're no safer when it freezes overnight. True.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker responds that side roads are not any safer when temperatures drop below freezing overnight.
segments.turkishExplanation: Gece ayaz yaptığında onlar da hiç güvenli olmuyor. Doğru.

segments.text: Next time, let's carpool until the thaw.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker suggests sharing car rides until the weather warms up and the ice melts.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bir dahaki sefere buzlar çözülene kadar arabayı ortak kullanalım.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to express criticism or regret about an action that did not happen in the past.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Geçmişte yapılması gerekip de yapılmayan eylemler için pişmanlık veya eleştiri bildirmek amacıyla kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: You should have called me before leaving the office.

quiz.question: In segment 3, what does the speaker imply by saying "You should have taken the back roads"?

options.text: Taking side roads would have been a better decision in the past.
The motorway was closed, so there was no other route available.
Side roads are always much faster than driving on a motorway.
The driver should turn around right now and leave the highway.
